cues: During furniture assembly, she turns a cross-headed screw to secure a hinge against the cabinet door.
A repairer uses a flat blade to loosen the tiny fastener inside a battery compartment.
The electronics casing opens after its recessed screws are backed out one by one.
At a workbench, a magnetic tip holds a small screw steady while fitting a circuit board.
A volcanic island rose above turquoise water, its black cliffs sheltering seabirds from strong ocean winds.
The librarian sorted returned novels by publication year before shelving them in the quiet reading room.
